title: Q-ADOPT-browser-preview-probe: executor probes a preview Worker through Browser Run internal hostnames
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** every rnd pass
**Done check:** grep:foundation/executor.py::preview.internal
**Prediction:** adoption_shipped >= 1 within 336 h
**Status:** open

After an executor change that touches a Worker, open the preview through a Browser Run browser with an internal hostname (agents 0.31.0) and probe the page before the PR merges. Paths: foundation/executor.py, tests/foundation/test_executor.py.

Adopted from Q-SCOUT-cloudflare-agents-cb441d6b: Browser Run internal hostnames let the executor open a preview Worker in a browser and probe it, which closes the verify-before-merge step without a public URL
